title: THE CARD IN THE DRAWER · The last bell
venue: the motel · a card left in room twelve's nightstand each month by a guest never seen · Box 12
logline: The seventh card, June: an angel with a trumpet, the dead rising from boxes. He redraws it as the school at 3:05 with the bell's jagged shape over the doors and the students coming out of the building as if out of the ground, and on the far sidewalk a man and an old dog not rising. The card names the fixture.

panels.composition: A single tall card filling the page, its border drawn as the wooden edge of a motel nightstand drawer; inside the border: a high school with a jagged bell shape over its doors and students pouring out drawn as if rising from the ground, a man and an old dog still on the far sidewalk. No numeral, no title; the card's name is the thing.
